review: Independent visual inspection of every fresh publication PNG at its captured size

publication_binding.note: The acceptance receipt reconciles the captured a93 source with the published source. Product sources did not change after the publication capture.

observations: Paper-size choices, the current A4 check mark, and the Page Layout entry use readable light foregrounds on the dark menu.
The open menu remains inside the window; the underlying dark document text and rulers remain visible.
The Layout ribbon, active tab, and horizontal and vertical ruler readouts are legible against their dark surfaces.
The dark grey page has light body text and visible colored headings; the application switcher remains compact.
The compact Layout controls retain distinct dropdown affordances, readable labels, and a visible active-tab underline.
The light paper and document text retain their expected appearance; ruler readouts are visible.
The margins menu shows Normal, Narrow, Moderate, Wide, and Page Layout with a current-value check mark.
The menu is anchored to Margins and its contents fit within the window.
At 900 by 760, ribbon tabs and Layout groups follow right-to-left ordering and fit without a rendered overflow warning.
Arabic controls remain visible, the English sample document keeps its own left-to-right layout, and the Page Layout launcher uses bounded wrapping/ellipsis.
At 900 by 760, the Layout groups remain visible with bounded wrapping for longer German labels.
The selected Layout tab, menu arrows, document viewport, and rulers remain distinguishable without a rendered overflow warning.
Columns and spacing fields, the disabled one-column separator option, preview, and Apply target are readable.
Apply and Cancel remain visible inside the dialog.
The open Page Layout dialog consistently uses dark surfaces with light labels, field values, helper text, and preview annotations.
The active tab and Apply button remain distinct; no light input-surface leak or clipped field is visible.
Precise margin values and units, section-scope explanation, page preview, and Apply target are visible together.
Tab labels and dialog actions remain within the dialog bounds.
Paper size, orientation, exact width/height with units, preview dimensions, and Apply scope are readable.
The selected Paper tab and dialog actions remain visible.
The dark Paragraph dialog has readable measurement, spacing, line-multiplier, and indentation controls.
The inactive special-indent amount is visibly disabled, and the visible pagination control and fixed actions remain inside the dialog.
The new Language downloads entry is visible at the top of the dark Settings dialog.
Appearance, language, units, document-pane switches, language detection explanation, ribbon customization, and Close are readable without clipping.
The former internal interaction-mode dropdown is absent from Settings.

limits: This visual review evaluates the captured Flutter widget surfaces and does not establish native macOS traffic-light or operating-system menu behavior.
The new downloads-manager dark route is covered by the accepted workspace regression; the Settings screenshot shows its entry, not an open downloads-manager window.
No claims of exhaustive localization, interactive behavior, or export-color correctness are made from screenshots; those are addressed by the scoped source review and tests.
